extracted.name: Javi's Really Real Mexican Ceviche
extracted.description: Shrimp and scallop ceviche is easy to make at home. The shellfish "cook" in a citrus marinade, resulting in an impressive entrée or appetizer.
instruction_lines: In a large glass or ceramic bowl, gently toss shrimp and scallops with lime juice and lemon juice. Mix in onion, cucumber, tomato, jalapeño, serrano, cilantro, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Cover the bowl and chill in the refrigerator until shrimp and scallops are opaque, about 1 hour.
